keyEvents.text: Goal! Inter Milan 1, Como 0. Francesco Pio Esposito (Inter Milan) left footed shot from very close range to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Djed Spence following a fast break.
Goal! Inter Milan 2, Como 0. Marcus Thuram (Inter Milan) right footed shot from the left side of the six yard box to the bottom left corner.
Substitution, Como. Samuele Ricci replaces Máximo Perrone.
Substitution, Como. Ivan Smolcic replaces Martin Baturina.
Second Half begins Inter Milan 2, Como 0.
Francesco Pio Esposito (Inter Milan) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Inter Milan. Henrikh Mkhitaryan replaces Piotr Zielinski.
Substitution, Inter Milan. Ange-Yoan Bonny replaces Francesco Pio Esposito.
Substitution, Como. Maxence Caqueret replaces Lucas da Cunha.
Substitution, Como. Mattia Liberali replaces Yan Couto.
Substitution, Como. Kaiki replaces Álex Valle.
Substitution, Inter Milan. Petar Sucic replaces Hakan Çalhanoglu.
Substitution, Inter Milan. Andy Diouf replaces Federico Dimarco.
Substitution, Inter Milan. Benjamin Pavard replaces Marcus Thuram.
Second Half ends, Inter Milan 2, Como 0.
